CAVEAT the memo did not find: 407 of the 1,984 match only through the USIS term; 188 of those contain no literal 'USIS' at all, because porter stems USIS to 'usi' and so matches 'USI', the United States of Indonesia (162 of the 188 hold that token; 80 are in frus1948v06 and 59 in frus1949v07p1, the two volumes that top the memo's per-volume table).
